artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan (6.5h) closing the five sapience activation-surface scoping gaps: three new verify-sapience-mcp.sh checks, an N-repeat agreement verdict in the context-scoping probe, two documentation rewrites, and a redeploy plus full gate run.

memory_candidates.content: In this repository, two coupled generated surfaces each have a named one-command repair that a plan should schedule in the SAME phase that moves the input, rather than deferring: adding any script to an extension's source store requires it in manifest.json's provides.scripts (check-extension-docs.sh Rule Q), repaired by `scripts/sync-manifest-scripts.sh --write`; and editing any indexed context/** file moves that file's index-entries.json line_count (Rule R), repaired by `scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh --write`. Neither check is commit-blocking here (no pre-commit hook is installed), but a phase whose own verification runs verify-deploy.sh gate 3 will fail on the drift, so same-phase reconciliation is the cheaper authoring choice. Separately: a plan phase that creates a NOT-YET-EXISTING test file cannot honestly claim a covering suite -- suite_selection_select returns __FULL_SWEEP__ for a path that is not on disk, and validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification measurement check flags any named suite as fabricated.
